questions.question: A shopkeeper sells a product at Rs. 80 after losing 20%. What is the cost price?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Selling Price (SP) = Rs. 80

Loss Percentage = 20%

**Formula Used:**

Cost Price (CP) = SP ÷ (1 - Loss Percentage/100)

**Calculation:**

⇒ CP = 80 ÷ (1 - 20 ÷ 100)

⇒ CP = 80 ÷ (1 - 0.2)

⇒ CP = 80 ÷ 0.8

⇒ CP = 100

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 100.**

questions.question: A shopkeeper mixes 2 kg of sugar at 40/kg with 3 kg of sugar at 50/kg. What is the price per kg of the mixture?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Weighted Average Price = [(Quantity₁ × Price₁) + (Quantity₂ × Price₂)] ÷ (Total Quantity)

Average Price = (2 × 40 + 3 × 50) ÷ (2 + 3)

Average Price = (80 + 150) ÷ 5 = 230 ÷ 5 = 46

**∴ The correct answer is ₹46.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Quantity of **Sugar A** = 2 kg | Price = ₹40/kg

Quantity of **Sugar B** = 3 kg | Price = ₹50/kg

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6862f92dbe74c32e85b863a4dcbc341c4045781b95cabd3befc5a44ec77b1f56.png] 

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total cost of **Sugar A** = 2 kg × ₹40/kg = ₹80

⇒ Total cost of **Sugar B** = 3 kg × ₹50/kg = ₹150

⇒ Total weight of the **mixture** = 2 kg + 3 kg = 5 kg

⇒ Total cost of the **mixture** = ₹80 + ₹150 = ₹230

⇒ Price per kg of **mixture** = Total Cost ÷ Total Weight

⇒ Price per kg = 230 ÷ 5 = ₹46

**∴ The correct answer is ₹46.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Alligation Rule

It states that (Quantity of Cheaper) ÷ (Quantity of Dearer) = (Price of Dearer − Mixture Price) ÷ (Mixture Price − Price of Cheaper).

Weighted Average Concept

questions.question: A car travels 150 km at 75 km/h. Time taken?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Distance = 150 km

Speed = 75 km/h

**Formula Used:**

Time = Distance ÷ Speed

**Calculation:**

⇒ Time = 150 ÷ 75

⇒ Time = 2 hours

**∴ The correct answer is 2 hours.**

questions.question: A is twice as efficient as B. A and B together can complete a work in 12 days. In how many days can A alone complete the work?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Efficiency ratio of **A** and **B** = 2 : 1.

Combined efficiency of **A + B** = 2 + 1 = 3 units/day.

Total work = Combined efficiency × Time = 3 × 12 = 36 units.

Time taken by **A** alone = Total work ÷ A's efficiency = 36 ÷ 2 = 18 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 18 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Efficiency of **A** is **twice** that of **B**.

Time taken by (**A + B**) together = 12 days.

 
 

 **Person**
 **Days**
 **Total Work**
 **Efficiency**
 
 

 **A**

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the efficiency of **B** be 1 unit/day.

⇒ Then, efficiency of **A** = 2 × 1 = 2 units/day.

⇒ Combined efficiency of (**A + B**) = 2 + 1 = 3 units/day.

⇒ Total Work = Combined Efficiency × Time taken together

⇒ Total Work = 3 × 12 = 36 units.

⇒ Time taken by **A** alone = Total Work ÷ Efficiency of **A**

⇒ Time = 36 ÷ 2 = 18 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 18 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Efficiency and Time Relationship

Efficiency is the rate of doing work. Total Work = Efficiency × Time. For a constant amount of work, efficiency is inversely proportional to time taken.

Ratio of Efficiency and Time

If the efficiency ratio of two workers is **x : y**, the ratio of time taken by them to complete the same work is **y : x**.

Combined Work Rate

When two or more people work together, their individual efficiencies (work done per unit time) are added to find the total rate of work.</p

questions.question: What is the selling price if the marked price is Rs. 750 and discount is 12%?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Marked Price = Rs. 750

Discount = 12%

**Formula Used:**

Selling Price = Marked Price × (1 - (Discount ÷ 100))

**Calculation:**

⇒ Selling Price = 750 × (1 - (12 ÷ 100))

⇒ Selling Price = 750 × (1 - 0.12)

⇒ Selling Price = 750 × 0.88

⇒ Selling Price = Rs. 660

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 660.**

questions.question: A metal cuboid measuring 40 cm x 20 cm x 10 cm is melted down and recast into small solid cubes of side 2 cm each for making children's building blocks. How many such cubes can be formed?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Length = 40

Breadth = 20

Height = 10

Side of cube = 2

**Formula Used:**

Volume of cuboid = length × breadth × height

Volume of cube = side³

Number of cubes = volume of cuboid ÷ volume of cube

**Calculation:**

⇒ Volume of cuboid = 40 × 20 × 10 = 8000

⇒ Volume of cube = 2³ = 8

⇒ Number of cubes = 8000 ÷ 8

⇒ Number of cubes = 1000

**∴ The correct answer is 1000.**

Same side lengths for both triangles.

⇒ By the SSS criterion

questions.question: A right prism has volume 1800 cm³ and height 20 cm. What is the area of the base?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Volume of prism = 1800 cm³

Height of prism = 20 cm

**Formula Used:**

Volume = Base Area × Height

Base Area = Volume ÷ Height

**Calculation:**

⇒ Base Area = 1800 ÷ 20

⇒ Base Area = 90 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 90 cm².**

questions.question: A 60-liter mixture contains milk and water in the ratio 2:1. If 12 liters of water is added, what will be the new ratio of milk to water?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Initial mixture parts = 2 + 1 = 3 units = **60 liters**.

1 unit = 20 liters ⇒ **Milk** = 40 L, **Water** = 20 L.

New **Water** = 20 + 12 = 32 liters.

New **Milk to Water ratio** = 40 : 32 = 5 : 4.

**∴ The correct answer is 5:4.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total Volume = **60 liters**

Initial Ratio (Milk : Water) = **2 : 1**

Water added = **12 liters**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a7253ee7031059e0038dc12f3d66d74545ae348b7e1d64d73974221b3b297da2.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total parts in **initial mixture** = 2 + 1 = 3

⇒ Quantity of **Milk** = (2 ÷ 3) × 60 = 40 liters

⇒ Quantity of **Water** = (1 ÷ 3) × 60 = 20 liters

⇒ After adding 12 liters of **water**, new quantity of water = 20 + 12 = 32 liters

⇒ New **Milk to Water ratio** = 40 : 32

⇒ Dividing by highest common factor 8: (40 ÷ 8) : (32 ÷ 8) = 5 : 4

**∴ The correct answer is 5:4.**

**__Additional Information__**

Ratio and Proportion

A **ratio** compares two quantities by division. If a:b is the ratio, 'a' is the antecedent and 'b' is the consequent.

Mixture Replacement Rule

When a part of a mixture is replaced with an equal quantity of one ingredient, the concentration of the other ingredient changes as (Initial × (1 − replaced/total)ⁿ).

Component Addition

When only one component is added to a mixture, the quantity of the other component remains **constant**, which is the key to solving most mixture problems.</p

questions.question: A circle has a radius of 5 cm. From a point P, which is 13 cm away from the center of the circle, a tangent is drawn to the circle, touching it at point T. What is the length of the tangent segment PT?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The **radius**, **tangent**, and **line joining the center to the external point** always form a **right-angled triangle**.

In this triangle, the **hypotenuse** is the distance from the center (13 cm) and one **side** is the radius (5 cm).

Using **Pythagorean triplets**: (5, 12, 13).

Since 5 and 13 are given, the remaining side (tangent) must be 12.

**∴ The correct answer is 12 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Radius** of the circle (OT) = 5 cm

**Distance** of point P from center O (OP) = 13 cm

**Formula Used:**

In a right-angled triangle ▵OTP (where ∠OTP = 90°):

OP² = OT² + PT² (**Pythagoras Theorem**)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f556db9c3d1c871ea817310e01e5d36839d7f07fb17b021622227c1a1cd39f0.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ In ▵OTP, OT ⊥ PT (**Tangent-Radius Property**)

⇒ PT² = OP² − OT²

⇒ PT² = 13² − 5²

⇒ PT² = 169 − 25

⇒ PT² = 144

⇒ PT = √144

⇒ PT = 12 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 12 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Tangent-Radius Property

A tangent at any point of a circle is perpendicular to the radius through the point of contact (∠OTP = 90°).

Length of Tangent from External Point

The length of a tangent drawn from an external point P to a circle with radius r and center distance d is given by √(d² − r²).

Common Pythagorean Triplets

Standard integer sets that satisfy a² + b² = c² include (3, 4, 5), (5, 12, 13), (8, 15, 17), and (7, 24, 25).</p

questions.question: A total of Rs. 650 is to be divided into three portions in the ratio of 1/4: 1/6 : 1/8 The first portion is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Total = 650

Ratio = 1/4 : 1/6 : 1/8

**Formula Used:**

Convert ratio to whole numbers

Share = Total × individual ratio ÷ sum of ratios

**Calculation:**

⇒ LCM of 4, 6, 8 = 24

⇒ Ratio = 6 : 4 : 3

⇒ Total ratio = 6 + 4 + 3 = 13

⇒ First portion = 650 × 6 ÷ 13

⇒ First portion = 300

**∴ The correct answer is 300.**

questions.question: In an election, 25% voters did not vote. Out of the votes polled, 20% were declared invalid. The winner secured 60% of the valid votes and defeated his rival by 2,400 votes. Find the total number of voters.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Non-voters = 25%

Invalid votes = 20%

Winner = 60% of valid votes

Margin = 2400

**Formula Used:**

Valid votes = total × voted% × valid%

Difference = (winner% - loser%) × valid votes

**Calculation:**

⇒ Voted = 75%

⇒ Valid = 80% of voted = 75 × 80 ÷ 100 = 60%

⇒ Let total voters = x

⇒ Valid votes = 60% of x = 0.6x

⇒ Winner = 60% of valid = 0.6 × 0.6x = 0.36x

⇒ Loser = 40% of valid = 0.4 × 0.6x = 0.24x

⇒ Difference = 0.36x - 0.24x = 0.12x

⇒ 0.12x = 2400

⇒ x = 2400 ÷ 0.12

⇒ x = 20000

**∴ The correct answer is 20000.**

questions.question: A sum of ₹10,000 is lent at a certain rate of simple interest. The amount at the end of 5 years is ₹15,000. If the rate of interest were 2% more, what would the simple interest be at the end of 5 years?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Principal = 10000

Amount after 5 years = 15000

Time = 5

Increase in rate = 2%

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

Amount = Principal + Interest

**Calculation:**

⇒ SI = 15000 - 10000 = 5000

⇒ 5000 = (10000 × R × 5) ÷ 100

⇒ 5000 = 500R

⇒ R = 10%

⇒ New rate = 10 + 2 = 12%

⇒ New SI = (10000 × 12 × 5) ÷ 100

⇒ New SI = 6000

**∴ The correct answer is 6000.**

questions.question: The areas of two similar triangles are in the ratio of 121:36. If the perimeter of the larger triangle is 55 units, what is the perimeter of the smaller triangle?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Area ratio = 121 : 36

Perimeter of larger triangle = 55

**Formula Used:**

Ratio of areas = (ratio of sides)²

Perimeter ∝ side

**Calculation:**

⇒ Ratio of sides = √(121 : 36) = 11 : 6

⇒ Ratio of perimeters = 11 : 6

⇒ Smaller perimeter = 55 × 6 ÷ 11

⇒ Smaller perimeter = 30

**∴ The correct answer is 30.**

questions.question: Rs. 4000 is invested in a scheme of compound interest (compounding annually) at the annual rate of 15 percent. What will be the difference between compound interest of second year and third year?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Principal = 4000

Rate = 15%

Time = 3 years

**Formula Used:**

Amount = P × (1 + R/100)ⁿ

Interest of year = Amount of that year - Amount of previous year

**Calculation:**

⇒ Amount after 1 year = 4000 × 115/100 = 4600

⇒ Amount after 2 years = 4600 × 115/100 = 5290

⇒ Amount after 3 years = 5290 × 115/100 = 6083.5

⇒ Interest of 2nd year = 5290 - 4600 = 690

⇒ Interest of 3rd year = 6083.5 - 5290 = 793.5

⇒ Difference = 793.5 - 690 = 103.5

**∴ The correct answer is 103.5.**

questions.question: The average of 5 consecutive odd natural numbers is 27. Previous 5 consecutive odd natural numbers to these 5 odd natural numbers are also included. What will be the average of newly added numbers?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

The **average** of 5 **consecutive odd numbers** is always the middle term.

Middle term of original set = 27.

The previous set also contains 5 consecutive odd numbers.

Since both sets have 5 terms, the difference between their averages is 2 × 5 = 10.

Average of new numbers = 27 − 10 = 17.

**∴ The correct answer is 17.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Average of 5 consecutive odd natural numbers = 27.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6559037f81531ed07999795544f4bc58cefaf1a818bcb4e378b9cc6e46b5b0e8.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the 5 **consecutive odd numbers** be: (x − 4), (x − 2), x, (x + 2), (x + 4)

⇒ **Average** = Sum ÷ 5 = [ (x−4) + (x−2) + x + (x+2) + (x+4) ] ÷ 5 = 5x ÷ 5 = x

⇒ Given average = 27, so x = 27.

⇒ Original numbers are: 23, 25, 27, 29, 31.

⇒ The 5 **consecutive odd numbers** previous to these are: 13, 15, 17, 19, 21.

⇒ Average of these newly added numbers = (13 + 15 + 17 + 19 + 21) ÷ 5 = 85 ÷ 5 = 17.

**∴ The correct answer is 17.**

**__Additional Information__**

Average of Arithmetic Progression

For any **consecutive numbers** (AP), the **average** is always (First term + Last term) ÷ 2 or the middle term if the count is odd.

Consecutive Odd/Even Numbers

In a sequence of **consecutive odd** or **even numbers**, the common difference between any two successive terms is always 2.

Shift in Average

If every number in a data set is increased or decreased by a constant value 'k', the **average** also increases or decreases by exactly 'k'.</p

questions.question: Average age of group A of 20 students is 40 years. Average age of group B of 40 students is 'x' years. Combined average age of group A and group B is 50 years. What is the value of 'x'?
questions.solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__ Ratio of students in **Group A** to **Group B** = 20 : 40 = 1 : 2 Deviation of **Group A** from **Combined Average** = 50 − 40 = 10 Since the student ratio is 1 : 2, the deviation ratio is inverse, i.e., 2 : 1. If 2 units = 10, then 1 unit = 5. Value of x = 50 + 5 = 55. **∴ The correct answer is 55.**

questions.question: P, Q and R working alone can complete a work in 15, 20 and 30 days respectively. All three of them started the work together but after 4 days P left the work. Q left the work 6 days before the work was completed. R completed the remaining work alone. In how many days was the total work completed?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

P = 15 days

Q = 20 days

R = 30 days

P leaves after 4 days

Q leaves 6 days before completion

**Formula Used:**

Work = LCM

Work done = rate × time

**Calculation:**

⇒ LCM of 15, 20, 30 = 60

⇒ P one day work = 60 ÷ 15 = 4

⇒ Q one day work = 60 ÷ 20 = 3

⇒ R one day work = 60 ÷ 30 = 2

⇒ Let total time = x

⇒ P works for 4 days

⇒ Q works for (x - 6) days

⇒ R works for x days

⇒ Total work = 60

⇒ 4 × 4 + 3 × (x - 6) + 2 × x = 60

⇒ 16 + 3x - 18 + 2x = 60

⇒ 5x - 2 = 60

⇒ 5x = 62

⇒ x = 62 ÷ 5

**∴ The correct answer is 62/5 days.**
